name: The Circle Closes In
source:
A distorted voice demands an answer – Mark, or Alex. Then, silence. The screen glows: Unknown caller…

[From [url=https://mdotstrange.itch.io/the-circle-closes-in]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個失真的聲音逼你作答——馬克，還是亞歷克斯？接著，一片寂靜。螢幕亮起：未知來電……
